gaps.sentence: I'm looking forward to ___ from you.
gaps.explanation: 'to' is a preposition in look forward to, so -ing follows: hearing.

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: We spent the whole morning ___ for tickets.
gaps.explanation: spend time + -ing: spent the morning queueing.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ over spilt milk.

gaps.explanation: refuse takes the to-infinitive: refused to pay.

gaps.sentence: She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).
